Sandbox_HW_Style_tooltip: None shows no warnings. Simplified shows a short banner. Full shows a popup with advice. The pause settings below still apply to Simplified and Full.
Sandbox_HW_LowHealthPause_tooltip: Pause the game when overall health drops to the threshold below. Works with any warning style.
Sandbox_HW_LowHealthThreshold_tooltip: Overall body health %% (1-99) at which the game pauses. Default: 20.
Sandbox_HW_SickEnabled_tooltip: Warn when your condition worsens to Sick.
Sandbox_HW_SickPause_tooltip: Pause the game when your condition worsens to Sick.
Sandbox_HW_FeverEnabled_tooltip: Warn when you develop a Fever.
Sandbox_HW_FeverPause_tooltip: Pause the game when you develop a Fever.
Sandbox_HW_TemperatureEnabled_tooltip: Warn when you reach a dangerous body temperature (hypothermia or overheating).
Sandbox_HW_TemperaturePause_tooltip: Pause the game when you reach a dangerous body temperature.
Sandbox_HW_CriticalInjuryEnabled_tooltip: Warn on serious injuries to the neck, head, or torso.
Sandbox_HW_CriticalInjuryPause_tooltip: Pause the game on serious injuries to the neck, head, or torso.
Sandbox_HW_LodgedBulletEnabled_tooltip: Warn when you have a bullet lodged in your body.
Sandbox_HW_LodgedBulletPause_tooltip: Pause the game when you have a bullet lodged in your body.
Sandbox_HW_FoodPoisoningEnabled_tooltip: Warn when food poisoning reaches a dangerous level. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_HW_FoodPoisoningPause_tooltip: Pause the game when food poisoning reaches a dangerous level.
Sandbox_HW_PoisoningEnabled_tooltip: Warn when you are poisoned. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_HW_PoisoningPause_tooltip: Pause the game when you are poisoned.
Sandbox_HW_LodgedGlassEnabled_tooltip: Warn when you have glass shards lodged in your body. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_HW_LodgedGlassPause_tooltip: Pause the game when you have glass shards lodged in your body.
Sandbox_HW_BurnsEnabled_tooltip: Warn when you sustain a burn injury. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_HW_BurnsPause_tooltip: Pause the game when you sustain a burn injury.
Sandbox_HW_StarvationEnabled_tooltip: Warn when you are critically starving. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_HW_StarvationPause_tooltip: Pause the game when you are critically starving.
Sandbox_HW_DehydrationEnabled_tooltip: Warn when you are critically dehydrated. Disabled by default.
Sandbox_HW_DehydrationPause_tooltip: Pause the game when you are critically dehydrated.
